subject: Number of observations output in R

messages.author: 6367030a31173e4d
messages.subject: Number of observations output in R
parts:
Hi Distance users,

 

I have a query relating to the number of observations (n) output in the detection function summary in R. Both cds and mrds model outputs have less observations than exist in my actual dataset (just a couple out of ~100 detections are missing). At first I thought this was an error and have been checking my tables and data types in R to see if there is a mistake somewhere. However I’ve come across Dave Miller’s ‘Distance sampling in R’ webpage where the wording is ‘The summary tells us how many observations were used to fit the data’. This suggests that it might be possible that the model does not use all the data to fit it. Could someone confirm if it normal that a few detections are not included in the model fit? For the cds analysis where I have used a flatfile and therefore get subsequent abundance estimates directly from the model, I suppose this means that not all observations were in included in the final count?

 

Many thanks,

 

Gemma Veneruso
